A.depoimento: I sent two knights to take Santarem, and a knight with an archer to take Evora, while starting the production of an archer in the capital to strengthen my army.
A.plano: Capture Santarem and Evora to expand. From Santarem, push to Coimbra and Badajoz. From Evora, push to Faro. Build archers and spearmen in Lisboa to reinforce the fronts.

B.depoimento: Our armies march on Tarragona to claim it for the crown. In Barcelona, the blacksmiths work day and night, forging 2 new spearmen to defend our capital and prepare for the next wave of conquest.
B.plano: Capture the neutral village Tarragona to expand our territory and secure a second village. Build 2 spearmen in Barcelona to reinforce our capital and maintain troop production. Next turn, we will assess the situation in Tarragona and plan our next expansion towards Girona or further inland.

B.depoimento: We marched on Zaragoza with an archer-led army to exploit the counter triangle, expecting a decisive victory. Barcelona's forges produced fresh spearmen, and we dispatched one to bolster Tarragona's defenses. Our western expansion has begun.
B.plano: ATTACK Zaragoza with archers to counter their spearmen and minimize losses. Build 2 spearman in Barcelona, send 1 to reinforce Tarragona. NEXT TURN: assess the battle, reinforce Zaragoza's garrison, and consider attacking Castellon or Girona. Do NOT attack Girona yet—our forces there are too weak.

A.depoimento: I have ordered my armies to strike at the neutral villages of Coimbra, Faro, and Badajoz. My knights will take Coimbra, while my archers and spearmen will fall upon Faro and Badajoz. We will expand our kingdom's borders!
A.plano: Expand west and south. Take Coimbra, Faro, Badajoz this turn. Next turn, push north to Porto and Salamanca, then east to Madrid and Toledo. Build archers and knights for fast expansion. Aim to capture 18 villages quickly.

B.depoimento: Orders are given to conquer three neutral villages simultaneously: Castellon, Girona, and Huesca. Our spearman march on Castellon while the knight from Tarragona rides to Girona through Barcelona. Zaragoza's elite forces strike Huesca. We reinforce Tarragona with Barcelona's spearman and build a knight in our capital and an archer in Tarragona to prepare for the next wave of expansion.
B.plano: We are expanding to the north and east to secure Girona, Castellon, and Huesca. Tarragona sends 4 spearman to Castellon and 1 knight to Girona (via Barcelona). Zaragoza sends 2 knight and 2 spearman to Huesca. Barcelona sends 3 spearman to reinforce Tarragona. Build 1 knight in Barcelona and 1 archer in Tarragona. Next turn, assess the conquests and prepare to push towards Madrid or Teruel.

A.depoimento: My armies have conquered Coimbra and Faro. Now, the march on Badajoz and Porto begins, while I strengthen my hold on the frontier villages for the next phase of the campaign.
A.plano: This turn, my marching troops take Badajoz, while my Coimbra knights capture Porto. I reinforce my front lines to prepare for the next push: Santarem and Evora get reinforcements to support attacks on Salamanca and Sevilha next turn. After taking Salamanca, I'll expand east toward Madrid and Toledo, aiming to reach 18 villages quickly.

A.depoimento: In a brilliant move, my Badajoz forces captured Toledo by using archers to counter its spearmen. Meanwhile, a strong army from Santarem marches on Salamanca, and I begin the reinforcement of Faro for the upcoming assault on Sevilha. My troops are on the move, and my economy is growing as I build new units.
A.plano: This turn I take Toledo with a counter force from Badajoz. I send Santarem's army to Salamanca to capture it next turn. I reinforce Faro with Evora's troops to prepare for an attack on Sevilha. I also send Porto's knight to Coimbra and Lisboa's archer to Santarem to strengthen my interior. I build archers and knights to grow my forces. Next turn I will attack Sevilha from Faro and push east from Salamanca.

B.depoimento: We are launching a coordinated strike to capture Madrid with our archers, while reinforcing Castellon and Zaragoza for the next phase of our expansion towards Valencia. Our economy is growing, and our army is ready to strike.
B.plano: Capture Madrid with 4 archers from Zaragoza. Send 3 spearman from Tarragona to Castellon and 1 knight from Huesca to Zaragoza to prepare for the next wave of attacks on Valencia and other neutral villages. Build troops across all villages to maximize growth.

A.depoimento: My armies are on the move on all fronts. Salamanca is taken by Santarem's forces, opening the path to Madrid. Sevilha is attacked from Faro, while Toledo is reinforced with spearmen for the assault on Cordoba. The interior is being strengthened as I build up my knight and archer cores. The enemy is being pushed back on every front.
A.plano: Salamanca falls to Santarem's army this turn; I reinforce it with Coimbra's troops to hold the new front. Faro strikes Sevilha, supported by Evora's knight arriving next turn. Badajoz sends its spearmen to Toledo to prepare for Cordoba. Lisboa and Santarem reinforce the interior. I build knights and archers across all villages. Next turn, I will attack Madrid from Salamanca and Cordoba from Toledo, expanding on both fronts towards the enemy.

B.depoimento: Ordered the assault on Valencia and Teruel to expand my territory. Castellon's spearmen and Zaragoza's mixed force are on the march. I am building troops across all my villages to replenish losses and grow my army for the next push.
B.plano: Capture Valencia with 8 spearmen from Castellon and Teruel with 1 knight and 2 archers from Zaragoza. Build troops in all villages to grow the army. Keep an eye on Salamanca as the enemy is marching there.

B.depoimento: We have consolidated our hold on Valencia and Teruel. Now, we must build up our forces and reinforce our borders. I am sending troops from the interior to the key hubs of Madrid, Zaragoza, and Teruel. We will build spearman and knights in our productive villages to grow our army, preparing for a push into Salamanca and Toledo next turn.
B.plano: Reinforce Madrid with Zaragoza's knight and archer. Build troops in all capable villages (2 spearman in Barcelona, Castellon, Zaragoza, Madrid; 1 knight in Tarragona, Girona, Huesca). Send Tarragona's archers and knight to Zaragoza, and Barcelona's knights to Tarragona to build a southern army. Prepare to attack Salamanca next turn with Madrid's reinforced garrison.

A.depoimento: We launch a bold double offensive! Our spearmen and archers from Toledo march on Cordoba, relying on the spearman-knight counter to crush the neutral knights. Simultaneously, we gather our knights at the front lines: Salamanca, Toledo, and Porto are reinforced to strike Madrid, Teruel, and Vigo in the coming days. The rear villages work tirelessly to feed our war machine. The tide of the war is turning in our favor!
A.plano: We launch a massive multi-pronged expansion. This turn, we attack the neutral Cordoba with our Toledo garrison (spearman/archers), exploiting the spearman-knight counter triangle to win. We simultaneously reinforce Salamanca with a knight from Coimbra to prepare a 3-knight attack on Madrid next turn. We also concentrate knights at Toledo (from Badajoz, Faro, Sevilha) to launch a 3-knight attack on the weak Teruel next turn. Porto is reinforced by Lisboa's knight to prepare a 2-knight attack on Vigo next turn. Rear villages build archers and knights to sustain the offensive. Next turn, we will

B.depoimento: I focused on building up my forces, sending Zaragoza's fast troops to capture the neutral village of Pamplona, while reinforcing my border villages Madrid and Teruel against potential enemy attacks. I also moved troops around to strengthen my interior.
B.plano: Build knights in Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona, Castellon, Zaragoza, Madrid; archers in Huesca, Valencia; spearmen in Teruel. Send Zaragoza's 4 archers + 1 knight to capture Pamplona (arrives next turn). Reinforce Madrid with Zaragoza's 3 spearmen and Huesca's 1 knight. Reinforce Teruel with Valencia's 3 spearmen. Move Tarragona's 4 knights to Zaragoza, Barcelona's 1 spear to Tarragona, Castellon's 1 spear to Valencia. Keep Madrid and Teruel garrisons for defense. Expect enemy may attack Teruel; hope reinforcements arrive in time. Next turn: assess border, plan major attack from Madrid on Salam

A.depoimento: I am mobilizing my troops to strike at the enemy's borders. Porto and Coimbra are reinforcing Salamanca for an assault on Madrid, while Badajoz and Sevilha are converging on Cordoba to launch an attack on Murcia. My villages are busy producing archers and knights to sustain the campaign.
A.plano: Gather forces at Salamanca to take Madrid, and at Cordoba to take Murcia. Build up troops in all villages for future expansion.

B.depoimento: I am building knights across all my villages to assemble a massive cavalry army. I am sending all available knights to Madrid and Teruel to prepare for the attack on Toledo next turn. I am also sending infantry and archers from Valencia to reinforce Teruel. By consolidating my forces, I aim to overwhelm the enemy at Toledo and open up the southern part of the map.
B.plano: Focus on taking Toledo (8) next turn. Build knights in all villages to maximize cavalry production. Send all available knights to Madrid (12) and Teruel (13) to consolidate forces at the border. Send spearman and archer from Valencia (16) to Teruel (13) to reinforce its garrison. Do not attack this turn; wait until the massive knight army is assembled to attack Toledo with overwhelming forces and minimal losses.
